sub: Enter a stock name or 6-digit code (e.g. 005930) in the search bar above to access all features at once.

deep.heading: Deep Analysis: an in-depth look at a single stock

realTimeChart.title: Live Chart & Indicators
realTimeChart.desc: Displays EMA, Bollinger Bands, and Stochastic on top of a candlestick chart.

financialIndicators.title: Investment Metrics & Financials
financialIndicators.desc: Organizes key financial metrics such as profitability and stability, plus annual/quarterly statements.

financialTimeline.title: Financial Timeline
financialTimeline.desc: Visualizes revenue, operating income, and net income trends across periods.

aiReport.title: AI Deep Report
aiReport.desc: Generates an LLM analysis report combining price action, financials, and technical indicators.

external.heading: External Factors: the bigger picture around a stock

rates.title: Base Rate · FX · Bonds
rates.desc: Examines the macro rate environment and FX trends alongside the stock.

industryIndex.title: Sector Index · Peers
industryIndex.desc: Compares the relevant sector index and how peer stocks react.

supplyDemand.title: Order Flow · Short Selling
supplyDemand.desc: Tracks investor trading trends and short-selling flows.

newsSentiment.title: News Sentiment + AI Report
newsSentiment.desc: Generates an LLM report combining news sentiment and external factors.
